{{Top|leg}}
A '''Beacon ship''' was a type of vessel used in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].

==Description==
These vessels were used by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] in a support role and were charged with providing [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates to early models of [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|''Nssis''-class Clawcraft]] as well as other ships within the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss fleet]] that lacked navigational computers. Depending on the length of a journey, these ships were often strung along travel routes where they coordinated smaller ships, as well as ensured that they were not lost in their travels. Early-model ''Nssis''-class ships could not make a hyperspace jump more than a day away from a beacon ship or similar source of astrographical coordinates.

==History==
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a beacon ship along with several squadrons of clawcraft were dispatched to help in the fight against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] until the [[Battle of Ithor|destruction]] of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].
